title: The Life Nobody Sees
headline: Your Private Life Shapes Your Public Character
tagline: Your public life eventually reveals what your private life has been rehearsing.
seo_title: Your Private Life Shapes Your Character (Luke 6:45) | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Character rarely appears suddenly; it is usually revealed suddenly. A devotional for men on Luke 6:45, Matthew 6:6 and the hidden life.
verse_text: For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.

scriptures.text: For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.
But when you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father, who is unseen.…
Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

items: We tend to think character is created in big moments.
The crisis.
The temptation.
The confrontation.
The moment everything goes wrong.

blocks.text: But often the big moment does not create character.
It reveals what has already been forming.

items: The angry explosion may have lasted thirty seconds.
But resentment had been rehearsed for months.
The affair became visible one day.
But fantasy, secrecy, entitlement and compromise may have been forming privately long before anyone knew.
The dishonest business decision happened in one meeting.
But the belief that winning matters more than integrity may have been developing for years.
The public moment looked sudden.
The formation was not.

sections.label: It Works the Other Way Too

items: Courage can appear suddenly, but may have been rehearsed privately through hundreds of small acts of obedience.
Generosity can appear in one extraordinary gift, but may have been formed through years of quietly releasing ownership.
Forgiveness can appear after a devastating offense, because someone spent years surrendering smaller offenses to Christ.
Faith can appear in crisis, because Scripture had been filling the mind before the crisis ever arrived.

blocks.text: The public moment is often simply where the hidden life becomes visible.

sections.label: Jesus Takes Us Beneath the Surface

items: Jesus says, “The mouth speaks what the heart is full of.”
The words reveal what the heart has been storing.
And Jesus tells us to pray in secret, to the Father who sees in secret.
The hidden life is not a lesser life.
It is where the visible life is being built.
Character rarely appears suddenly. It is usually revealed suddenly.
The life everyone eventually sees is being built in the life almost nobody sees.
Some of your greatest spiritual victories will occur where nobody but God knows there was ever a battle.
Pay attention to what you practice when nobody is watching. You may be rehearsing the person you are becoming.
